method: Shared = intersection of the four student browser graphs. Ranking uses production analyzer compressed_size: level 6 DEFLATE plus an 18-byte gzip wrapper per module part. Per-module gzip equivalents do not add to whole-file gzip. Analyzer recompiles in production mode with analyze-build IDs, so its filenames differ from production first-load stats. Whole first-load/shared totals independently sum actual transferred files at gzip level 9. Exclude the analyzer-only nomodule polyfill and all SSR/server/non-JS outputs.
package_allocation_method: All shared modules classified by their innermost node_modules package; application/generated and bundler modules have explicit groups. Package gzip-equivalent sums are independent module compression, not measured package download sizes. estimated_shared_transfer_bytes proportionally allocates actual shared gzip-9 transfer using those weights, with rounding reconciled to the measured total; this is an estimate, not exact per-package compression.
